sql: SELECT COALESCE(l.k, r.k) AS k, l.a, r.b FROM (VALUES (1, 10), (2, 20)) AS l(k, a) FULL OUTER JOIN (VALUES (2, 200), (3, 300)) AS r(k, b) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY k
SELECT l.k AS lk, r.k AS rk FROM (VALUES (1), (2)) AS l(k) FULL OUTER JOIN (VALUES (3), (4)) AS r(k) ON l.k = r.k ORDER BY COALESCE(l.k, r.k)
